items.title: SF retiree loses $500,000 in pig butcher scam, then falls for the same scam again
items.dek: SAN FRANCISCO (KGO) -- 7 On Your Side previously reported about a San Francisco retiree who lost his life savings to a cruel scam known as "pig butchering." The
items.body: SAN FRANCISCO (KGO) -- 7 On Your Side previously reported about a San Francisco retiree who lost his life savings to a cruel scam known as "pig butchering." The man, a retired city gardener, thought he was starting a new life with a new love. Instead, he lost $500,000. Now we've learned he immediately fell for the same scam again. submitted by /u/TylerFortier_Photo [link] [comments]
